```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggrepel)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

res     <- readRDS(here("outputs", "analysis.rds"))
d_ref   <- res$d_ref
hitters <- res$hitters
saison  <- max(d_ref$season)
d_q     <- filter(d_ref, qualifie)

nom_court <- function(x) sub("^(.*), (.*)$", "\\2 \\1", x)
slug_joueur <- function(x) x |>
  stringi::stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") |>
  str_replace_all("[^A-Za-z]+", "_") |>
  str_remove("_$")

profils_en <- c("Contact"         = "Contact hitter",
                "Sous-puissance"  = "Under-powered",
                "Équilibré"       = "Balanced",
                "Puissance brute" = "Raw power")
couleurs_profils <- c("Contact"         = "#2E86AB",
                      "Sous-puissance"  = "#A23B72",
                      "Équilibré"       = "#3BB273",
                      "Puissance brute" = "#F18F01")

# Priority lever and development priority -----------------------------
leviers <- c("Contact"         = "Add bat speed, protect contact",
             "Sous-puissance"  = "Add bat speed (physical screen first)",
             "Équilibré"       = "Maintain; decisions & timing",
             "Puissance brute" = "Contact quality & swing efficiency")

jays <- d_ref |>
  filter(jays) |>
  mutate(
    # A "balanced" profile can still hide one clear weakness
    levier = unname(case_when(
      profil == "Équilibré" & pct_squared_up_per_swing < 35 ~ leviers[["Puissance brute"]],
      profil == "Équilibré" & pct_avg_bat_speed < 35        ~ leviers[["Contact"]],
      profil == "Équilibré" & pct_oz_swing_percent < 35     ~ "Swing decisions (chase less)",
      TRUE                                                  ~ leviers[as.character(profil)])),
    # Percentile of the metric the lever targets
    pct_levier = case_when(
      str_detect(levier, "bat speed")     ~ pct_avg_bat_speed,
      str_detect(levier, "Contact quality") ~ pct_squared_up_per_swing,
      str_detect(levier, "chase less")    ~ pct_oz_swing_percent,
      TRUE                                ~ NA_real_),
    # Development score: low production + a clear, targeted weakness
    score = round(((100 - pct_est_woba) + (100 - pct_levier)) / 2),
    statut = case_when(
      petit_echantillon                                     ~ "Watch",
      levier == leviers[["Équilibré"]] | pct_est_woba >= 70 ~ "Maintain",
      TRUE                                                  ~ "Ranked")
  )

# Ranking among reliable samples with a clear lever
jays <- jays |>
  mutate(rang = if_else(statut == "Ranked",
                        as.integer(rank(-if_else(statut == "Ranked", score, -Inf),
                                        ties.method = "first")),
                        NA_integer_),
         priorite = case_when(statut != "Ranked" ~ statut,
                              rang <= 3          ~ "Top 3",
                              TRUE               ~ "Next"),
         priorite = factor(priorite, levels = c("Top 3", "Next", "Watch", "Maintain")))

# Main strength / weakness (MLB percentile vs qualified hitters) -------
forces <- c(avg_bat_speed        = "Bat speed",
            squared_up_per_swing = "Contact quality",
            whiff_per_swing      = "Whiff avoidance",
            brl_percent          = "Barrels")

fw <- jays |>
  select(player_id, paste0("pct_", names(forces))) |>
  pivot_longer(-player_id, names_to = "var", values_to = "pct") |>
  mutate(lab = forces[sub("^pct_", "", var)]) |>
  group_by(player_id) |>
  summarise(force     = paste0(lab[which.max(pct)], " (", max(pct, na.rm = TRUE), ")"),
            faiblesse = paste0(lab[which.min(pct)], " (", min(pct, na.rm = TRUE), ")"))

jays <- left_join(jays, fw, by = "player_id")

# Weighted averages (by competitive swings): Jays vs MLB ---------------
moy <- function(d) d |>
  summarise(across(c(avg_bat_speed, swing_length, squared_up_per_swing,
                     whiff_per_swing, oz_swing_percent, bb_percent,
                     k_percent, est_woba),
                   ~ weighted.mean(.x, swings_competitive, na.rm = TRUE)))
m_jays <- moy(jays)
m_mlb  <- moy(d_ref)
```

<small>[← League overview](index.html)</small>

**`r saison` season · `r nrow(jays)` hitters tracked (`r sum(jays$qualifie)` qualified, `r sum(jays$petit_echantillon)` small samples)**

```{r resume, results='asis'}
hauts <- jays |> filter(priorite == "Top 3") |>
  arrange(rang) |> pull(name) |> nom_court()
nb <- table(factor(jays$profil, levels = names(profils_en)))
nb_txt <- paste0(nb, " ", tolower(profils_en[names(nb)]), collapse = ", ")

cat(glue::glue(
  "::: {{.callout-note appearance=\"simple\"}}\n",
  "Weighted by swings, Jays hitters average **{sprintf('%.1f', m_jays$avg_bat_speed)} mph** ",
  "of bat speed vs {sprintf('%.1f', m_mlb$avg_bat_speed)} mph for MLB, with a squared-up ",
  "rate of {percent(m_jays$squared_up_per_swing, 0.1)} vs ",
  "{percent(m_mlb$squared_up_per_swing, 0.1)}. Profiles: {nb_txt}.",
  "{if (length(hauts) > 0) paste0(' **Top 3 development priorities:** ', paste(hauts, collapse = ', '), '.') else ''}\n",
  ":::\n"
))
```

## Roster map

```{r carte, fig.width=10, fig.height=5.8}
ggplot(d_q, aes(swing_length, avg_bat_speed)) +
  geom_point(colour = "grey85", size = 1.4) +
  geom_point(data = jays, aes(colour = profil, shape = petit_echantillon),
             size = 3.4, stroke = 1.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = jays, aes(label = nom_court(name), colour = profil),
                  size = 3.3, max.overlaps = Inf, seed = 1,
                  box.padding = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = couleurs_profils,
                      labels = function(x) profils_en[x], name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = 16, `TRUE` = 1),
                     labels = function(x) ifelse(x == "TRUE",
                                                 "Small sample (< 300 swings)",
                                                 "Reliable sample"),
                     name = NULL) +
  labs(title = paste("Blue Jays hitters on the MLB swing map,", saison),
       subtitle = "Grey: qualified MLB hitters. Colour: profile. Open circle: small sample.",
       x = "Swing length (ft)", y = "Bat speed (mph)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = "grey35"))
```

## Development priorities

```{r priorites}
jays |>
  arrange(priorite, rang, desc(score)) |>
  mutate(
    fiche  = paste0("fiche_", slug_joueur(name), ".html"),
    Player = if_else(file.exists(here("reports", fiche)),
                     paste0("[", nom_court(name), "](", fiche, ")"),
                     nom_court(name))
  ) |>
  transmute(
    `#`                 = if_else(is.na(rang), "", as.character(rang)),
    Player,
    Swings              = paste0(swings_competitive,
                                 if_else(petit_echantillon, " ⚠", "")),
    Profile             = profils_en[as.character(profil)],
    `Main strength`     = force,
    `Main weakness`     = faiblesse,
    `xwOBA (pct) / wOBA` = paste0(sprintf("%.3f", est_woba), " (", pct_est_woba,
                                  ") / ", sprintf("%.3f", woba)),
    `Priority lever`    = levier,
    Score               = if_else(is.na(score), "", as.character(score)),
    Priority            = as.character(priorite)
  ) |>
  kable(align = "rlrllllrrl")
```

<small>Numbers in brackets are MLB percentiles (1–100) vs qualified hitters. wOBA = actual production. **Score** (0–100) = average of (100 − xwOBA percentile) and (100 − percentile of the metric targeted by the lever): the lower the production and the clearer the targeted weakness, the higher the priority. Hitters with a reliable sample and a clear lever are ranked; the **Top 3** are highlighted. **Watch**: fewer than 300 competitive swings, early signals only (⚠). **Maintain**: balanced profile or xwOBA at the 70th percentile or above. Click a name to open the individual report.</small>

## Team vs MLB

```{r equipe-mlb}
metr <- c(avg_bat_speed        = "Bat speed (mph)",
          swing_length         = "Swing length (ft)",
          squared_up_per_swing = "Squared-up / swing",
          whiff_per_swing      = "Whiff / swing",
          oz_swing_percent     = "Chase rate",
          bb_percent           = "Walk %",
          k_percent            = "Strikeout %",
          est_woba             = "xwOBA")

fmt <- function(v, x) case_when(
  v %in% c("squared_up_per_swing", "whiff_per_swing") ~ percent(x, accuracy = 0.1),
  v %in% c("oz_swing_percent", "bb_percent", "k_percent") ~ sprintf("%.1f%%", x),
  v == "est_woba"     ~ sprintf("%.3f", x),
  v == "swing_length" ~ sprintf("%.2f", x),
  TRUE                ~ sprintf("%.1f", x))

fmt_diff <- function(v, x) case_when(
  v %in% c("squared_up_per_swing", "whiff_per_swing") ~ sprintf("%+.1f pts", 100 * x),
  v %in% c("oz_swing_percent", "bb_percent", "k_percent") ~ sprintf("%+.1f pts", x),
  v == "est_woba"     ~ sprintf("%+.3f", x),
  v == "swing_length" ~ sprintf("%+.2f", x),
  TRUE                ~ sprintf("%+.1f", x))

tibble(var = names(metr),
       j = unlist(m_jays[names(metr)]),
       m = unlist(m_mlb[names(metr)])) |>
  transmute(Metric = metr[var],
            `Blue Jays` = fmt(var, j),
            MLB = fmt(var, m),
            Difference = fmt_diff(var, j - m)) |>
  kable(align = "lrrr")
```

<small>Averages weighted by competitive swings, all tracked hitters.</small>

## Year-over-year changes

```{r evolution}
s0 <- saison - 1
s1 <- saison

# Note: inside filter(), "jays" would refer to the jays COLUMN of
# hitters, not to the table of Jays players -> take the ids first.
ids_jays <- jays$player_id

mov <- hitters |>
  filter(player_id %in% ids_jays) |>
  select(player_id, name, season, avg_bat_speed,
         squared_up_per_swing, est_woba) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(player_id, name), names_from = season,
              values_from = c(avg_bat_speed, squared_up_per_swing, est_woba)) |>
  drop_na()

if (nrow(mov) > 0) {
  mov |>
    mutate(
      d_bs  = .data[[paste0("avg_bat_speed_", s1)]] - .data[[paste0("avg_bat_speed_", s0)]],
      d_sq  = .data[[paste0("squared_up_per_swing_", s1)]] - .data[[paste0("squared_up_per_swing_", s0)]],
      d_xw  = .data[[paste0("est_woba_", s1)]] - .data[[paste0("est_woba_", s0)]]
    ) |>
    arrange(desc(d_xw)) |>
    transmute(
      Player               = nom_court(name),
      `Bat speed (mph)`    = sprintf("%.1f → %.1f (%+.1f)",
                                     .data[[paste0("avg_bat_speed_", s0)]],
                                     .data[[paste0("avg_bat_speed_", s1)]], d_bs),
      `Squared-up / swing` = sprintf("%.1f%% → %.1f%% (%+.1f pts)",
                                     100 * .data[[paste0("squared_up_per_swing_", s0)]],
                                     100 * .data[[paste0("squared_up_per_swing_", s1)]],
                                     100 * d_sq),
      xwOBA                = sprintf("%.3f → %.3f (%+.3f)",
                                     .data[[paste0("est_woba_", s0)]],
                                     .data[[paste0("est_woba_", s1)]], d_xw)
    ) |>
    kable(align = "lrrr")
}
```

<small>`r s0` values may come from another team for players acquired since. Sorted by change in xwOBA.</small>

---

<small>Data: Baseball Savant, public Statcast data (bat tracking, expected stats, exit velocity). Profiles, percentiles and model are based on the `r nrow(d_q)` qualified MLB hitters in `r saison` (570+ competitive swings); other hitters are placed against that reference. Internal biomechanics and force-plate data would turn these leads into measured diagnoses. Report: Hugo Leligny.</small>
